pressure.contract: Actual native counters and executed directed channel traffic; cut rates use data-lane width, not sideband. Row classes are controller observations, not command traces. Average utilization and attempts do not identify critical-path stall. Controller read latency begins at native acceptance and excludes upstream waiting; per-job/context sums overlap.

traffic.contract: Counts actually committed logical payload with different source/destination routers; not a hop count or energy. Full executed flit distance comes separately from BookSim physical channels; input copies remain explicit per consumer.

down.contract: Mathematical ready uses original producer completion; actual H delivery is additionally checked by the system audit. Fetch interval overlaps and summed leads are observations, not exclusive critical-path stall or saved makespan.

prefetch_audit.contract: One waiting Down/cluster; two unchanged coupled fetch contexts; full SRAM storage, real native returns and original mathematical starts. Zero early allocations or negative speedup remain valid outcomes.
